commit.message:
docs: refresh README with verified capabilities, examples, and API reference (#2)

- Replace the minimal upstream README with a production-grade refresh:
  badges, an At-a-Glance capability diagram, curated Key Capabilities,
  Installation (NuGet + build-from-source, both real, verified paths),
  Quick Start and Additional Examples, a full API Reference table mirroring
  reference.aspose.org's own module organization, Scope and Limitations
  (each bullet independently verified against the real, current C++
  source), Documentation & Resources, Development and Testing, and License.
- Every code example, API claim, and format-support claim independently
  verified against the real, current source in this repository -- no
  content is carried forward from this pipeline's own internal artifacts.

Verification: every hard-gate check in this project's readme-refresh
validation suite passes against this candidate except one pre-existing,
unrelated checker false-positive (a fenced-code-block language tag
misread as a prose format reference), disclosed and left as a known
checker limitation, not a content defect.

Co-authored-by: babar-raza <babar-raza@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
